name: Aquaculture Fish and Old Rods
description: What stays from Aquaculture, and what old rods still do.

pages.title: Aquaculture Fish and Old Rods
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Aquaculture's **fish** now bite on any rod, each in its own biome.
- Its **rods, hooks, lines, bobbers and Tackle Box** can't be crafted any more.
- Rods you **already own** still work, the old way.
- Fillet knives, Worm Farm, Neptunium and its food all stay.

Tide makes every new rod, and its tackle doesn't fit Aquaculture's rods (or the other way round). Two tackle systems side by side would only confuse, so Aquaculture's fishing gear is retired and its fish moved over to Tide.\
\
Retired items are hidden from JEI. Copies you own stay in your inventory and keep working.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Where Aquaculture fish bite:**

- **Jungle rivers:** arapaima, piranha, tambaqui, Arrau turtle.
- **Hot rivers** (desert, badlands, savanna): bayad, boulti, capitaine, synodontis.
- **Swamps:** perch, box turtle.
- **Rivers:** gar, minnow, pink salmon.

- **Fresh water**, by season and temperature: bluegill, smallmouth bass, rainbow and brown trout, muskellunge, carp; catfish at night.
- **Ocean and beach:** Atlantic cod, halibut and herring, blackfish, Pacific halibut, pollock, red grouper, tuna, jellyfish.
- **Mushroom fields:** red and brown shrooma.
- **Twilight Forest:** starshell turtle.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Bluegill, carp, catfish, rainbow trout, smallmouth bass, tuna and arapaima also existed in Tide, and piranha, carp and tuna in Hybrid Aquatic. Each is one fish now, Aquaculture's, so the journal lists it once and recipes take one item.

pages.title: Old Rods
pages.text: An Aquaculture rod you already have keeps Aquaculture's own fishing: cast, wait for the splash, reel in. There is no timing game, and its catches come from Aquaculture's tables, not Tide's.
Its hook, line, bobber and bait still go in through the rod's menu or an old Tackle Box. Aquaculture hooks don't fit Tide rods.

**Hybrid Aquatic hooks** held in the **off hand** while you cast work with old Aquaculture rods and with [#](2E5AAC)[Alloyed](entry://industry/alloyed)[#]()'s Steel Fishing Rod, which also fishes the old way. On a Tide rod they go on at the [#](2E5AAC)[Angling Table](entry://fishing/angling_table)[#]() instead.

pages.title: Fillet Knife
pages.text: Iron, Gold, Diamond and Neptunium Fillet Knives still craft. Craft one with a fish for Raw Fillets; a Farmer's Delight knife on the cutting board does the same.

pages.title: Worm Farm
pages.text: Still makes **Worms**, which work as bait in Tide rods: [#](2E5AAC)[Bait](entry://fishing/bait)[#]().

Neptunium still comes from [#](2E5AAC)[Neptune's Bounty](entry://fishing/crates)[#](), now reeled in on any rod in open water. The Neptunium rod is out of that loot.\
\
Create **Integrated Farming**'s [#](2E5AAC)[Fishing Nets](entry://food/integrated_farming)[#]() are not rods. They fish on moving contraptions exactly as before.
